description: Browse the full curated list of Philippine scholarships with optional filters (level, provider type, region). Use ph_search_scholarships instead when you have a specific question.

level.description: School level: senior_high, college, graduate, or tech_voc (TESDA)

offset.description: Number of programs to skip, for pagination

provider_type.description: Who runs it: government (national), lgu (city), private (foundation/company), university

region.description: Text to match in the regions served, e.g. "NCR", "Davao", "nationwide"

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for structured data

name: ph_list_scholarships
title: List Philippine scholarships
